verses.t: At Sāvatthī. Seated to one side, Venerable Rādha said to the Buddha: “Sir, they speak of ‘Māra nature’. What is of Māra nature?” “Rādha, form is of Māra nature. Feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness are of Māra nature. Seeing this … They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
